source_en: My documents, I had them ready. Jana Sokolova, second residential row.
You noticed the dress. It's for a ceremony later.
A wedding. The date keeps moving. [[whisper:I don't remember]] when it started.
How long have you worn it?
It holds its shape. The seamstress on my floor mends it.
I sell flowers on the residential row. Funerals, mostly, lately.
Widows. They pay in ration coupons. I take them.
He does. He gets home later now. I wait. I'm good at that.
I know this part. It's the parts in between I lose.
